description: Application view model for error view model data (not stored as a database table).
business_purpose: Used to track and report error view model records for the System & Communication area.
record_granularity: One object represents one error view model result row.

columns.name: RequestId
columns.description: Unique identifier of the error view model.

business_rules: ErrorViewModel is an application view model or report DTO populated in code, not a table stored in the database.

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against ErrorViewModel: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT RequestId) when counting error view model records; joins can duplicate rows.
Populated in application code (for example from a stored procedure or joined query); query the underlying tables instead.
